# CMS-4201-F: MA plans must follow Traditional Medicare coverage criteria

- Citation: CMS, Contract Year 2024 MA and Part D Final Rule (CMS-4201-F), published 2023-04-12, effective 2024. Fact sheet: https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/fact-sheets/2024-medicare-advantage-and-part-d-final-rule-cms-4201-f ; CMS FAQ: https://www.aha.org/system/files/media/file/2024/02/faqs-related-to-coverage-criteria-and-utilization-management-requirements-in-cms-final-rule-cms-4201-f.pdf
- Year: 2023 (effective 2024)
- Tier: 1
- Key provisions: MA plans must follow Traditional Medicare coverage criteria (NCDs, LCDs, and general benefit conditions in regulation; CMS cites SNF coverage criteria as an example). Plans may use internal, publicly accessible criteria only where Medicare criteria are not fully established.
- Related: Medicare Benefit Policy Manual, Chapter 8 (SNF coverage: skilled nursing daily, or skilled therapy 5 days a week). https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/bp102c08pdf.pdf
- Limits: read from search summaries, not the rule text. How CMS enforces it was not researched.
- Relevance: a denial reason stricter than Chapter 8 may be non-compliant, which turns an appeal into a rules check.
